title: Last Day In Florida
one_paragraph_synopsis: In the final day in Florida, the office reflects on Dwight's departure and promotion, discusses office conflicts, and prepares for upcoming changes, including Jim's farewell and Robert California's plan to sabotage the Sabre store presentation.
